description: A Flutter/Dart source file defining a ChangeNotifier controller for managing chess game state, engine interactions, move history, and AI difficulty levels. It integrates a chess engine, handles move validation, undo/redo, and AI move generation with a simple negamax algorithm.

classes.name: MoveRecord
classes.description: Model representing a single move with notation, source and target squares, and whether it was made by AI.

classes.name: AIDifficulty
classes.description: Enumeration for AI difficulty levels: easy, medium, hard.

classes.name: ChessGameController
classes.description: Main class managing the chess game state, incorporating engine logic, move history, AI move computation, and game outcome detection.

methods.name: setDifficulty
methods.description: Update AI difficulty setting and persist it.

methods.name: loadDifficulty
methods.description: Load AI difficulty setting from persistent storage.

methods.name: newGame
methods.description: Reset the game to start a new match.

methods.name: makePlayerMove
methods.description: Attempt to make a move for the player, returning success status.

methods.name: aiMoveNow
methods.description: Trigger AI to compute and make a move immediately.

methods.name: _aiMoveAsync
methods.description: Internal method to perform AI move asynchronously, including a delay to simulate thinking.

methods.name: _chooseBestMove
methods.description: Select the best move for the AI using a negamax search with adjustable depth based on difficulty.

methods.name: _negamax
methods.description: Implementation of the negamax algorithm with alpha-beta pruning for move evaluation.

methods.name: _evaluateBoard
methods.description: Evaluate the current board state, assigning a score based on material and mobility.
